posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
Things I've tried so far without success:

Setup

Lost to Chokepoint with the Adamant Sentinels (and others)

Lost to Chokepoint with AZ, Bunker, Unity

 

Attempt 1

Won against Chokepoint in FF tower with AZ, Legacy, Wraith, Tachyon, Ra (no unlock)

Particulars: AZ never regained HP.  Did massive damage with Isothermic by playing one shots with imbued fire and Legacy buffs and having everyone hit him with fire.  

 

Attempt 2

Won against CP in FF tower. Same team. 

Particulars: AZ was incapped after doing massive damage.  Both of his modules had been played.  AZ was only incapped hero. 

 

Attempt 3

Won against CP in FF tower. Same team. 

Particulars: AZ got out every equipment, Glacial Structures, and Subzero Atmosphere. CP was defeated using FB drain.
